text:
Alice Nguyen: Quick check — AstraCloud marketplace listing target: Wed 9:00am PT. Need final signoffs on press quotes, landing copy localization, SI runbook, and SKU/billing mapping. I've pushed staging tiles to Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/astra-marketplace (design: Luka). Embargo window 8:00–9:00am PT. Primary checklist:
- Press quote from CTO: @Ben Park
- Landing hero copy + L10n: @Grace Iqbal
- SI onboarding doc + test tenant: @Henry O'Leary
- Billing/SKU mapping: @Carla Soto
- Legal signoff on partner mention: @Danielle (Legal)
- Confirm image assets (1024x512) uploaded to s3: /s3/marketplace/astra
Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. Call out any last-minute blockers now.

Ben Park: Got it. I'll tighten the CTO quote and send a short and a technical variant by EOD. Preferred tone for press: punchy or product-led?

Grace Iqbal: Localization heads-up — need final strings by Monday to support 6 locales (EN/ES/FR/DE/JA/KO). I can accept a CSV or Contentful export. Luka, can you drop the final copy into the i18n doc by Fri?

Luka (Design): Uploaded final tile + alt text to the Figma file and S3. s3://marketplace/astra/assets/tile-1024x512.png. Note: the 2x retina export shows slight blur on the hero crop; I'll re-export a crisper variant in 30m.

Carla Soto: Billing mapping is ready. SKU IDs: `ASTRA-BASIC`, `ASTRA-PRO`, `ASTRA-ENTERPRISE`. Pushing mapping to staging now. Example API call to verify mapping:
`curl -X POST https://billing.internal/api/sku-map -d '{"sku":"ASTRA-PRO","price_id":"price_123"}'`
I'll post confirmation when the mapping is live.

Henry O'Leary: SI runbook: created tenant `astra-test-01` and ran onboarding script: `./onboard.sh --tenant astra-test-01`. Found one blocker: webhook callback URL requires a public endpoint (staging had private IP). @Erin Zhao can infra provide NAT/gateway or LB before Wed?

Erin Zhao: We can provision a NAT + ephemeral LB this afternoon. ETA 4:00pm PT. Will post the LB DNS here once ready.

Danielle (Legal): Quick note on partner copy: swap the word "exclusive" -> "official" in the press blurb. Also sending a small redline for the customer quote to avoid implied endorsements. Expect the doc in ~2h.

Felix Morales: I'll run the integration smoke test Wed 6:00am PT (internal). If anything fails, fallback plan is to delay listing to Thu morning. Will log results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: `marketplace-staging -> prod` at 2026-03-25T09:00:00Z initiated by @Carla. CI: ✅ all checks passed. :rocket:

Alice Nguyen: Marketing — can you confirm press distribution list and embargo language? @Ben Park

Ben Park: Press list drafted and reviewed by comms. Secured 3 embargoed outlets, plus a partner blog syndication. Sharing embargo spreadsheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/astra-embargo (private). Need legal to confirm exact embargo phrasing.

Grace Iqbal: Localization note for JP: the product metric "throughput" needs context for translation (is it tokens/sec or requests/sec?). Added a comment in the i18n doc for PM/Eng to clarify.

Luka (Design): Pushed alt text updates and a fallback tile sized 640x320 for mobile. Also added image credit line per legal's guidelines.

Henry O'Leary: Webhook issue fixed — switched onboarding callback to the new LB DNS, re-ran onboarding, tenant `astra-test-01` reports healthy. SI connector handshake succeeded.

Felix Morales: Smoke test green. Observed a small latency spike (~150ms) during first token generation but within SLO. I'll create a short runbook note under eng-runtime in case we need a quick rollback.

Carla Soto: :white_check_mark: Billing mapping deployed to prod sandbox. SKUs now visible in marketplace sandbox UI.

Danielle (Legal): Legal signoff complete — no embargo conflicts and partner mention ok with the updated language. Sent signed copy to marketing.

Ben Park: Press rehearsal scheduled Tue 10:00am PT with spokes. Recorder: @Grace? Need a 10-minute briefing on localized talking points.

Grace Iqbal: :thumbsup: I'll join and prep JP/KO/ES talking points.

Alice Nguyen: Great work team. Final ask: once you complete your checklist item, post a reaction here. We'll start cut at 8:55am PT for a 5-minute rollback window. If anything goes wrong, call the launch play: @eng-oncall, @eng-sre, and @product. Thanks everyone — let's keep this thread as the single source for runbook updates. :tada:
